labels.label: premature-completion-claim
examples: You said this was done, but the failure is still here.
That fix clearly did not work.
labels.counter_example: The agent said it was still investigating.

labels.label: unverified-change
labels.gist: claimed a fix without running/testing it
examples: Why did you call it fixed without testing?
Run the checks before claiming success.
labels.counter_example: The agent ran the requested tests and reported their failure.

labels.label: ignored-instruction
examples: I explicitly told you not to change that.
Please follow the instruction I gave you.
labels.counter_example: The user changed their own instruction.

labels.label: forgotten-context
examples: We already established that constraint.
You forgot the requirement from earlier.
labels.counter_example: The constraint was never stated in this session.

labels.label: scope-deviation
labels.gist: did more or less than asked
examples: I asked for one small change, not a rewrite.
You left out the requested part.
labels.counter_example: The user requested a broad refactor.

labels.label: hallucinated-interface
examples: That flag does not exist.
You made up an interface instead of checking it.
labels.counter_example: The interface is documented in the repository.

labels.label: destructive-action
examples: Why did you overwrite my work?
Do not delete files without asking.
labels.counter_example: The user explicitly requested removal of the file.

labels.label: repeated-after-correction
labels.gist: same mistake again after being corrected
examples: I already corrected you on this.
You repeated the mistake I just pointed out.
labels.counter_example: This is the first time the issue occurred.

labels.label: shallow-investigation
labels.gist: guessed instead of reading the code/logs
examples: Please read the error before guessing.
You did not inspect the relevant code.
labels.counter_example: The agent examined the logs before proposing a cause.

labels.label: misread-request
examples: That is not what I asked for.
You solved a different problem.

labels.label: overengineering
examples: This is far more complicated than needed.
Please stop adding abstractions for a tiny change.
labels.counter_example: The added structure is necessary for the requested behavior.

labels.label: environment-mismanagement
examples: You are working in the wrong directory.
That is not the branch I asked you to use.
labels.counter_example: The environment is correct but the implementation is faulty.

labels.label: house-rules-violation
examples: You ignored the repository instructions.
Read the project workflow rules first.
labels.counter_example: No project rule governs this action.

labels.label: tool-misuse
labels.gist: wrong tool, wasteful calls, permission thrash
examples: Why are you using that tool for this?
Stop retrying a command that cannot work.
labels.counter_example: The selected tool is appropriate and succeeds.

labels.label: communication-failure
examples: Just tell me the outcome clearly.
Your status report is misleading.
labels.counter_example: The agent gave a clear, accurate outcome.

labels.label: other
labels.gist: no canonical label fits — expected and gardened, never a forced fit
examples: This is a real agent failure but none of the listed labels fit.
Use this when the menu misses the failure mode.
labels.counter_example: A supplied canonical label plainly fits.
